description: Search Vinted second-hand fashion across 27 country domains, pull item details, seller closets, profiles, shop data, feedback, brands and categories.

brandId.description: Numeric brand ID or brand URL. Discover IDs with Search brand registry.
brandId.title: Brand ID or URL (mode=byBrand)

brandIds.description: Numeric brand IDs, e.g. [53] for Nike.
brandIds.title: Brand IDs filter (mode=search)

brandKeyword.description: Keyword to search the Vinted brand registry.
brandKeyword.title: Brand keyword (mode=byBrandSearch)

catalogIds.description: Numeric category IDs, e.g. [1904] for Women.
catalogIds.title: Catalog IDs filter (mode=search)

color.description: Single colour filter. Choose any to leave it unfiltered.
color.title: Color filter (mode=search)

condition.description: Vinted condition. Choose any to leave it unfiltered.
condition.title: Condition filter (mode=search)

containsKeyword.description: Drop items whose title or description does not contain this keyword (case-insensitive). Without item details only the title is searched.
containsKeyword.title: Title or description contains keyword

country.description: Vinted market to query. The market controls currency, language and local inventory.
country.title: Country / market

deepSearch.description: Vinted returns at most 960 results per query. Deep search splits the query into price bands so it can collect more (more requests, slower).
deepSearch.title: Deep search past 960 results

feedbackType.description: All reviews, member-written reviews, or Vinted's automatic sale-completion entries.
feedbackType.title: Feedback type (mode=byUserFeedbacks)

includeItemDetails.description: Open each item page for description, colour, material, category, condition ID, upload age, all photos and seller rating. One extra request per item.
includeItemDetails.title: Include item details

includeSellerStats.description: Add seller rating, feedback count, item/sold counts, followers and shop identity (one profile request per distinct seller).
includeSellerStats.title: Include seller stats / shop

materialIds.description: Numeric material IDs from Vinted's Material facet (e.g. 44 = Cotton).
materialIds.title: Material IDs filter (mode=search)

maxItems.description: Hard cap on emitted records. Values above 960 need deep search.
maxItems.title: Max items

minRating.description: Drop items whose seller rating is below this value (0–5). Items without a rating pass through. Automatically enables seller stats.
minRating.title: Minimum seller rating

mode.description: search: keyword/filters → items. byUrl: explicit Vinted item, member, brand, catalog or search URLs. byUser: profile + closet. byBrand / byCatalog: listings for a brand or category. byBrandSearch: brand registry. byUserFeedbacks: seller reviews.
enumTitles: By URL (item / member / brand / catalog / search)
mode.title: Scrape mode

priceFrom.description: Minimum price in the market's local currency.
priceFrom.title: Min price (mode=search)

priceTo.description: Maximum price in the market's local currency.
priceTo.title: Max price (mode=search)

searchText.description: Free-text keyword. Leave empty with a brand/category filter to browse. A bare run defaults to adidas.
searchText.title: Search query (mode=search)

sizeIds.description: Numeric Vinted size IDs. Use the size facet shown on a Vinted search URL.
sizeIds.title: Size IDs filter (mode=search)

urls.description: Item, member, brand, catalog or filtered search URLs. Mixed country domains are supported.
urls.title: Vinted URLs (mode=byUrl)

userId.description: Numeric Vinted user ID, username, or member URL.
userId.title: User ID, username or URL (mode=byUser / byUserFeedbacks)

title: Vinted Scraper Input
